records.class: THIRD-PARTY SELLER GUIDE (PDF text extracted locally)

statements: If your ESP32-CAM came with a camera module labeled RHYX M21-45 (or GC2145), it is not compatible with the default settings
The RHYX M21-45 does not support JPEG. It only supports Raw Color (RGB565).
Ensure only the AI_THINKER model is uncommented
If you try to use UXGA or SVGA with RGB565 mode, the data is too large for the ESP32 to handle, and the stream will crash.
The RHYX labeled camera seems to be a GC2145, not OV2640.
It doesn't support compression (so no JPEG at all)
Also you may need to limit resolution to QVGA or QQVGA.
facts.note: reporter's board was an ESP32-S3-CAM, not HW-818

facts.claims: AI-Thinker pin map; PIXFORMAT_JPEG at VGA 'works'
facts.conflict: contradicts E4, E14 and E15 on JPEG; no evidence shown
